title: KOIOS Food Scale, 33lb/15kg Digital Kitchen Scale Weight in Grams and Ounces for Cooking Baking, 1g/0.1oz Precise Graduation, Batteries and Type-C Charging, Tare Function, LCD Display, Black
description:
About this item
[Precise Weight & Sensitive Sensors] Built-in four sensitive load sensors, upgraded K7H digital food scale can give you accurate weighing within a short time. Adopts anti-slip design, it improves safety and stability. Range of measurement: 0.1oz to 33lbs (3g to 15 kg). 1g or 0.1oz increments when adding ingredients.
[Battery & Type-C Charging] Powered by Type-C port and comed with 2 AAA batteries, you have more choice for charging. Press once to turn on, long press 3s to turn off. Kitchen scale turns off automatically if the displayed weight remains unchanged for 3 mins.
[5 Units & LCD Display] You can easily switch between different units: g, kg, lb:oz, fl'oz, ml to meet your different needs. Equipped with a large backlit LCD display with white fonts for easy reading.
[Tare Function & Smart Alarm] The Tare function subtracts the weight of the plate or container, easy to get accurate ingredient weights. Adopted advanced chip, food scale for kitchen has low battery and overload indication to ensure the accuracy of measurement.
[Waterproof Tempered Glass & Easy to Store] Made of waterproof tempered glass, K7H food weight scale can protect against food residue and water damage. 9.0 x 6.3 inch suitable size beats small cheap scales for it has enough platform for weighing various ingredients. Hidden hook design for easy storage.

Dimensions:
USB Cord w/Wall Port On: 39.5 inches not counting the prongs that go in the outlet. If you measure the cord alone from tip of usb-c end to tip of USB end then it is 38.5 inches in length.
Scale Glass Top Surface: 9.5 inches L X 6.5 inches W (The glass top surface is the largest part of the scale over hanging the base. The base gradually tapers down to 9 in L X 5.5 in W. It sits on 4 rubber pads attached to the bottom for stability. You can see those in the pictures.)
Scale Height: 1 inch

This scale is fantastic! It’s sleek, modern and easy to operate. It has a Tare button so you can place containers, paper plates, bowls etc on it and then zero it out before adding your food items. No math needed. I like that it gives weight measurements in detail.
- Ounces to the tenth decimal 0.0
- Pounds to 0: 00 equalling 0lbs & 00oz.
- ML in whole numbers
- Grams in whole numbers
- Kilograms to the 3rd 0.000
I’m on a weight loss program and am a Type 2 Diabetic. I need precise weights not rounded up to the nearest whole number. It charged quickly right out of the box. Although it did have a charge, I didn’t know if it had a full charge or not. Plugged it in anyway. It has not been plugged in since and I use it daily. The manual says how long to charge it for full charge but it’s been a couple months. So I don’t remember. I will add that it does have an auto shutoff function but I physically turn it off as soon as I’m done using it. I received it March 5-6 2025 and set it up immediately. So it’s been over 2 months since I charged it. I’m very pleased. You can change the weight measuring units easily. I really like the black glass top. Looks really sharp on my counter and it’s easy to clean or to see if you’ve gotten it cleaned completely. I try not to sit items on top of it that I’m not actually weighing like when it’s powered off between uses. I’ll sit a roll of paper towels on it so others don’t put a glass or anything else on it. It is slim in design and would easily fit in a drawer laid flat on top of dish towels, pot holders or whatever. I’m a little lazy so it sits on my counter 24/7. the cord for charging is in the drawer of my island where I use it. I’m very happy I decided to get one. Initially I said that I was not going to weigh my food but some serving sizes are weight based. This was a great purchase and value for the cost.Muy prácticos si haces pastelería,So far, so good!Love the size of this scale. It's super easy to use and the back up light makes the numbers bold, bright and easy to see. Would recommend.It has a really nice big LED screen , so easy to read and clean. The buttons are so responsive too. I love the tare feature. The in off button is in the front and the measuring options grams, mg, oz , ml, etc is great! It is longer than my other scale so I can use a larger container on the scale. Exactly what u was hoping for!! It’s rechargeable too with usb to usb c charging cord! I bought these white one. It looks so clean. Very well made. Would highly recommend! I use it mostly so far for making sour dough bread but will clearly use for other baking and measuring foods for diet as well.Works great! just as described, no complaines here. It's a joy to use. Also appealing to the eyes.I didn't have weight calibration to know if this is truly accurate but it seems so. I use it mostly to weigh out my food and nutrients for my cats. I also weigh my kitten in it for now and it seems close. I have to put him in a tiny basket. But when I used this scale I got he was 5.2 lbs and when he went to the vet a couple days later they said he was exactly 5 lbs. The 2 oz difference could have been him shifting and moving. It's hard to keep him on there. I'll eventually need to get him a real animal scale but this works great for now.

I like the size. It's bigger than my last scale that was small and crappy. It broke in about 2 years. This one is easy to clean and nicely made. I'm assuming that auto shut off works since the batteries seem to last long. I typically try to shut off each time myself. I like that the buttons are smooth into the glass top so if you spill anything you don't have cracks to clean in. Overall really great value.I use the same multiple times a day to precisely track my caloric intake. I absolutely love it. I had a different scale that I really didn’t like this one is nice. It’s clean. The glass is easy to clean. It works. I wish I didn’t have an on off button and it auto sensed when I put something on it, but this is kind of a minor an annoyance. battery lasts a long time.To level set the review, I use my scale for portion measuring and also baking (more accurate and repeatable). Below is a quick list of the pros and cons:

Pros:
- Easy to read numbers (lights up blue when you change the weight)
- Large area to place measuring bowl (allows for large quantities while still being able to read numbers)
- Rechargable: I charged it upon receiving it and haven't charged it again for 2 months while using it multiple times a day (It shuts off after 4 minutes, or you can turn it off manually)

Cons:
- Extremely sensitive (this is overall a pro, but when adding small amount it can bounce between a few grams for a bit which can be tedious at times)
- Quite large (again for me this is a plus, but if you want the most compact scale you can find, this is not it)
- While sitting, the blue light goes off and numbers are hard to read

Overall, I love this scale. I think the look is incredibly sleek. Not having to keep batteries for it is also wonderful and the size is great for my applications (I cook large amounts of protein at one go and use large measuring bowls). I highly recommend and I actually returned a different scale in order to get this one.

Photos: next to amazon fire 8" and with a 6 quart measuring bowl I believe (blue screen lit up to show that weight was added)This is my second kitchen scale, the original still works but this one has two HUGE advantages over the old one:
1- It's USB rechargeable, no batteries to change...LOVE
2- I can actually READ it with a bowl sitting on it...a MUST

I tested it with a few items and it's accurate, I am using it for sourdough bread making and I love it.
reviews_1s:
Please beware of calling the number or trying to gain support using the online features. I do not know how to report this another way. I tried calling because the links were not working to access the user manual for the KOIOS Kitchen Scale Model # EK9380HR. I called the customer support number to ask for support and the man on the phone asked, so, "well, what do you want from me?" Then I asked, "The links to the user manual are not working and I am wondering if I have to use a phone app in order to use this scale?" It is for my mom and I didn't want to have her worry about learning how to use an app in order to use this scale every time. Then, he started asking for my info (name, address, etc.) and once he asked for my debit card number, I said I was not going to provide that over the phone but would be happy to give my order number to 1) confirm my purchase and 2) ask for a refund (these were the reasons he wanted this). As soon as I said no I didn't feel comfortable giving that info a second time, he hung up on me. The only thing I can think of nowadays when this happens is that somehow there is a scam. Thankfully, when I went back on AMAZON I found the user manual; however, I am worried about the lack of customer service and also the potential for scamming other people. I am hoping that if there are any problems in using this product, that I can get support that is needed and it not be scammy. and whoever can monitor this for potential scam gets this information.I wanted to love this scale. I need something reliable when baking bread. It worked great once. Then it started to take awhile to "warm up" or else it would switch units on its own, tare on its own, or change weight measurement repeatedly during final measurement. Now it won't hold a charge and has to be plugged in before using, wait for it to "warm up" and hope its going to measure correctly. Too late to return, I no longer have the box. Disappointed.Have only had for 2 months and scale already quit working. Of course it’s too late for return policy. I use the scale everyday and I finally thought I’d upscale from the scale I’ve had for years. I guess that’s what I get for trying to upgrade.Would not recommend. I purchased 3 and within 1 week, 1 stopped charging and the other 2 died shortly after. Also it has the old usb charger and not C-type charge. Old stock. DO NOT BUY!This is a nicely designed rechargeable balance but with a MAJOR flaw: it's grossly inaccurate.This scale worked great until the batteries died. I bought this specifically because it is supposed to be battery powered. There is no battery access.Change units from ounces, lb, ml, etc is very difficult. I'd say 75% of the time I can't get it to change and it's stuck on ml. I'd be able to deal with it if it would default to grams. Tare weight button doesn't do anything. I ended up cycling the power off and back on, with the bowl on the scale, to zero it out.

I threw mine in the trash after 1 week.We always wanted a rechargeable scale rather than a battery operated one which we do own already. Unfortunately this one was not accurate and the connector for recharging was really weird. It showed a macro usb slot but used a but used a mini usb. It seemed they used an old case with a newer inside. Also the unit didn’t show a status light or image of battery charging so we had no idea if it was charging or how much of a charge was left. My friend owns a similar model with this same company so I had him come over and he said the unit looked similar to his, his had a white background light also made from Kios but this one was blue light. His showed charging and had a battery indicator but mine did not. He said it was probs lay defective or maybe the new ones don’t come with an indicator. Another weird thing was the instructions did not match the unit I had either.False advertising!! I bought this because it said that it is waterproof and even shows a picture of being rinsed under water as part of the advertisement! The description clearly says "waterproof" right in the title, but when I received it the directions for cleaning states that it needs to be cleaned with a "slightly damp cloth".

I don't like being lied to and I will be getting my money back for thisThis broken after the second use. We are unable to charge it anymore which makes it useless
